summary.text: Claire Reynolds is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent August Pfluger in Texas's 11th District. A lawyer who was born in Indiana and moved to Texas in 2007, she has not held elected office. She is campaigning on affordability, health care, immigration reform and reproductive rights in a district she says was redrawn to entrench Republican control.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she was born in Indiana and grew up in central Illinois.

Earned a journalism degree from Northwestern University's Medill School of Journalism and a law degree from the University of San Diego School of Law, and passed the California bar, according to her campaign website.
Moved to Texas in 2007. She lives in Austin, which she says was placed in the 11th District by redistricting, and she describes raising her family in Texas.

In a Ballotpedia survey response, she describes working in the State Bar of Texas's Office of the Chief Disciplinary Counsel and, in the year before the survey, volunteering as a pro bono attorney with Lawyers for Good Government's Fund Protection Clinic, advising organizations affected by federal grant cuts.
Has not previously held elected office; won the Democratic nomination in the March 3, 2026 primary.
